ashrams.name: Gopal Baba Ashram – Sri Shanti Dham (Main)
ashrams.subTitle: Spiritual Headquarters & Ganga Ghat Meditation Center
ashrams.description: The primary spiritual seat of Pujya Gopal Baba, dedicated to Vedanta teachings, uninterrupted daily Annadanam, and spiritual retreats on the banks of sacred Ganga.
ashrams.address: Plot 108, Shanti Kunj Road, Near Saptrishi Ghat, Haridwar (Demo Coordinates)

ashrams.name: Gopal Baba Ashram – Anand Kuteer
ashrams.subTitle: Bhakti Yoga & Cow Sanctuary (Gaushala) Center
ashrams.description: Established for Bhakti Sadhana, Srimad Bhagavatam discourses, sacred cow service, and heritage temple preservation in the holy land of Braj.
ashrams.address: Kailash Nagar, Parikrama Marg, Raman Reti, Vrindavan (Demo Coordinates)

ashrams.name: Gopal Baba Ashram – Tapovan Retreat
ashrams.subTitle: Yoga, Meditation & Ayurvedic Healing Sanatorium
ashrams.description: Nestled amidst the Himalayan foothills, offering intensive dhyana retreats, scriptural study, and charitable holistic healthcare.
ashrams.address: Badrinath Road, Upper Tapovan, Rishikesh (Demo Coordinates)

roles.name: operations_admin

roles.name: content_manager

roles.name: volunteer
roles.description: Devotee registration, seva allocation, and event coordination.

donationCategories.name: Akshaya Patra Daily Annadanam
donationCategories.description: Provide wholesome sanctified meals (Maha Prasad) to thousands of visiting pilgrims, sadhus, and underprivileged families.

donationCategories.name: General Ashram Seva Fund
donationCategories.description: Unrestricted contribution used for daily pujas, temple maintenance, electricity, water, and emergency welfare.

donationCategories.name: Mandir & Yatri Niwas Construction
donationCategories.description: Sponsor construction of eco-friendly pilgrim guest rooms, meditation halls, and solar power installations.

donationCategories.name: Kamadhenu Gaushala & Cow Seva
donationCategories.description: Fodder, veterinary medical care, and shelter for over 250 indigenous Desi cows maintained across ashram branches.

donationCategories.name: Guru Purnima & Mahashivratri Sponsorship
donationCategories.description: Sponsorship of major festival rituals, floral decorations, Vedic yagnas, and live broadcast arrangements.

donationCategories.name: Veda Pathashala & Student Scholarship
donationCategories.description: Support free traditional Vedic education, boarding, books, and uniforms for young Vedic scholars.

announcements.title: Maha Kumbha Parva Special Satsang & Chandi Yagna Announced
announcements.content: Under the divine guidance of Pujya Gopal Baba, a 3-day Chandi Homa and continuous Akhanda Ramayan recital will be held from December 12th to 14th at Haridwar Ghat.

announcements.title: Winter Blankets & Warm Cloth Distribution to Rural Pilgrims
announcements.content: The Ashram Seva Trust will distribute 5,000 thermal blankets and warm clothes across foothill villages. Devotees may contribute or register as seva volunteers.

announcements.title: Gita Jayanti 18 Chapters Chanting & Prasad Mahotsav in Vrindavan
announcements.content: Join us at Anand Kuteer Vrindavan on Margashirsha Shukla Ekadashi. Over 2,000 devotees will chant the complete Bhagavad Gita followed by special Annadanam prasad.

announcements.title: 10-Day Residential Silent Dhyana Sadhana Camp Registration Open
announcements.content: Applications are invited for the winter silent meditation retreat at Tapovan, Rishikesh. Limited to 60 sadhakas. Prior registration mandatory.

announcements.title: New Solar Kitchen & Automated Chapati Maker Inauguration
announcements.content: To support 10,000 daily meals with zero carbon footprint, our state-of-the-art solar steam cooking system is now operational at the central Annadanam hall.

announcements.title: New Gaushala Shed Extension Completed at Vrindavan
announcements.content: Thanks to generous donor contributions, a sheltered shed with fresh water misting and automated fodder cutters now accommodates 50 newly rescued cows.

announcements.title: Daily Morning Ganga Aarti Timing Adjusted to 06:15 AM
announcements.content: Devotees are advised that in accordance with sunrise changes for winter, the morning Maha Mangala Aarti at Haridwar Ghat will commence at 6:15 AM sharp.

announcements.title: Free Ayurvedic Health & Pulse Diagnostics Camp
announcements.content: Senior Vaidyas from Kerala will provide free consultation and herbal medicines at Rishikesh Tapovan campus on Sunday from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM.

announcements.title: QR-Based Digital Darshan & Annadanam Tokens Introduced
announcements.content: Pilgrims can now scan QR codes situated at main gates to quickly view daily dining hours, prasadam token numbers, and ashram maps on their smartphones.

announcements.title: Sri Radha Krishna Jhulan Utsav Recorded Video Archive Available
announcements.content: HD recordings and photo albums of the Jhulan Utsav are now published on the official devotee portal and YouTube channel for global devotees.

announcements.title: Kartik Deepotsav: 21,000 Earthen Lamps Lighted at Ghats
announcements.content: A divine spectacle of 21,000 ghee diyas lit up Haridwar Shanti Ghat amidst Vedaghosha and Vedic chants by over 100 students of our Pathashala.

announcements.title: Himalayan Forest Tree Plantation Seva Concludes Successfully
announcements.content: Volunteers planted 3,500 native broadleaf trees including Deodar, Rudraksha, and Bel along the Tapovan hillsides to prevent monsoonal erosion.

announcements.title: Volunteer Registrations Open for Upcoming New Year Pilgrimage Rush
announcements.content: Devotees wishing to dedicate 3 to 7 days in crowd control, Annadanam serving, and shoe counters during late December are requested to sign up online.

announcements.title: Vrindavan Heritage Water Well (Baori) Restoration Complete
announcements.content: The 200-year-old heritage stone stepwell near the parikrama marg has been rejuvenated and filtered, providing potable water to pilgrims.

announcements.title: Audited Annual Financial Report & Seva Transparency Statement Released
announcements.content: In alignment with TTD standards of transparency, the Ashram Trust has published its certified donation utilization statement for the last financial year.

events.title: Maha Pournami
events.locationDetails: Main Satsang Mandap, Plot 108, Shanti Kunj Road, Near Saptrishi Ghat, Haridwar (Demo Coordinates), Haridwar
events.foodRequirements: Continuous Annadanam: Breakfast and Full Lunch and Dinner Facility
events.volunteerRequirements: 25 volunteers for crowd guidance and prasad counters

events.title: Grand Gita Jayanti Mahotsav & Akhanda Yagna
events.description: An auspicious 3-day spiritual congregation featuring complete 18-chapter chanting of the Bhagavad Gita, scholarly discourses by revered Mahants, and grand evening Ganga Arati.
events.locationDetails: Main Satsang Hall & Ganga View Courtyard, Haridwar
events.foodRequirements: Continuous Annadanam: Breakfast (Poha/Idli), Full Satvik Lunch (Khichdi, Dal, Roti, Subzi, Kheer), Dinner (Kadhi Khichdi). Approx 5,000 plates/day.
events.volunteerRequirements: 40 Seva volunteers needed for prasadam distribution, 20 for footwear and crowd guidance, 10 for audio-visual streaming.

events.title: New Year Sankalpa & Akhanda Hanuman Chalisa Path
events.description: Welcome the New Year with 108 continuous recitations of Hanuman Chalisa, special prayer for global peace, and prasad distribution for all pilgrims.
events.foodRequirements: Hot herbal tea, fruit prasad, and continuous Halwa & Khichdi prasad counter.
events.volunteerRequirements: 50 volunteers for night shifts and registration desks.

events.title: Vrindavan Braj Ras Samagam & Raas Leela Mahotsav
events.description: Traditional classical Raas Leela enacted by acclaimed Mathura artists, followed by devotional bhajans and Srimad Bhagavatam discourses.
events.foodRequirements: Makhan Mishri, Malpua, and complete Braj Bhojan prasadam for all attendees.
events.volunteerRequirements: 25 volunteers for flower arrangements and devotee hospitality.

events.title: Himalayan Winter Dhyana & Pranayama Intensive
events.description: A guided residential yogic meditation workshop conducted by senior yogis focusing on Patanjali Yoga Sutras, inner silence, and Himalayan breathing techniques.
events.foodRequirements: Strict Sattvic Ayurvedic detox meals: freshly pressed juices, steamed greens, sprouted legumes, cow ghee kichari.
events.volunteerRequirements: 8 resident volunteers for hall sanitization and herbal tea service.

events.title: Makar Sankranti Holy Ganga Snan & Til-Gud Annadanam
events.description: Sacred sunrise dip at Haridwar Saptrishi Ghat with Vedic Surya Namaskar, traditional Til-Gud laddu and Pongal prasad distribution to 8,000 pilgrims.
events.foodRequirements: Massive scale Pongal, Til laddu, warm spiced buttermilk, Khichdi.
events.volunteerRequirements: 60 safety volunteers along bathing ghats and food counters.

events.title: Gopashtami Maha Gau Seva & Fodder Samarpan Day
events.description: Special worship of Surabhi cows at the Kamadhenu Gaushala, honoring traditional cattle keepers and educational workshops on organic cow-based agriculture.
events.foodRequirements: Chana Gur, banana, and sweet porridge for cows; Puri Sabji and Halwa for visiting families.
events.volunteerRequirements: 30 volunteers for animal care and donor guidance.

events.title: Vasant Panchami Saraswati Yagna & Aksharabhyasam
events.description: Auspicious initiation ceremony into alphabets and education for young children with divine blessings of Maa Saraswati and Pujya Babaji.
events.foodRequirements: Kesari Bhath (sweet saffron rice), Boondi laddu, Puri Aloo.
events.volunteerRequirements: 15 educational volunteers assisting parent seating and sloka booklets.

events.title: Maha Shivaratri Akhanda Rudrabhishek & Jagaran
events.description: Four Prahar worship of Lord Shiva throughout the holy night with milk, bilva patra, sugarcane juice, and divine Dhrupad vocal recitals.
events.foodRequirements: Phalahari prasad (Sabudana Khichdi, Kuttu Poori, fruit chaat, warm almond milk) for fasting devotees.
events.volunteerRequirements: 100 volunteers deployed across 4 shifts throughout the 24-hour festival.

events.title: International Yoga Day Himalayan Youth Conclave
events.description: Over 500 yoga students gather on the banks of Ganga for standardized Common Yoga Protocol, philosophical panel discussions, and sound healing.
events.foodRequirements: Nutritious protein salad, sprouts, lassi, fruit bowls, khichari.

events.title: Guru Purnima Maha Mahotsav (Past Milestone)
events.description: Devotee tribute to the lineage of Sanatana Dharma Gurus with holy Pada Puja, charitable eye camp, and record Annadanam serving 25,000 pilgrims.
events.foodRequirements: Mass Annadanam mega kitchen deployed; 28,000 meals served.
events.volunteerRequirements: 250 volunteers managed security, medical, and dining halls.

events.title: Sri Krishna Janmashtami Maha Abhishek & Midnight Arati
events.description: Celebration of the birth of Bhagavan Sri Krishna with 108 herbs panchamrit abhishek, celestial swinging jhula, and grand devotional kirtan.
events.foodRequirements: 56 Bhog prasad offerings distributed to every pilgrim.
events.volunteerRequirements: 75 volunteers on security and crowd cordons.

events.title: Sharad Navaratri Saptashati Parayana & Durga Homa
events.description: Nine days of unbroken Devi Mahatmyam chanting and Vedic sacrificial offerings for prosperity, peace, and spiritual protection.
events.foodRequirements: Special Vrata bhojan, Kheer, and daily Kanya Puja feast.
events.volunteerRequirements: 45 volunteers for havan materials and queue management.

socialPosts.title: Divine Morning Arati on the Ghats of Haridwar
socialPosts.caption: The radiant fire of arati illuminating the sacred ripples of Mother Ganga. Start your day with devotion, peace, and surrender at the lotus feet of the Divine. #GopalBabaAshram #Haridwar #GangaArati #SpiritualDawn #SanatanaDharma

socialPosts.title: Daily Suprabhatam & Panchang Update
socialPosts.caption: 🌸 Hari Om! Today is Margashirsha Krishna Pratipada. Daily Annadanam commences at 12:00 PM at Haridwar & Vrindavan branches. Thought for the day: 'Renounce ego, embrace all living beings with selfless compassion.' - Pujya Gopal Baba

socialPosts.title: Kamadhenu Gaushala Seva: Protecting Sacred Desi Breeds
socialPosts.caption: Our indigenous Gir and Sahiwal cows receiving winter health tonics, fresh sugarcane grass, and warm shelter at Vrindavan. Sponsor a cow's monthly fodder today through our verified digital portal. #CowProtection #GaushalaSeva #Vrindavan

socialPosts.title: Essence of Katha Upanishad - Discourse by Pujya Gopal Baba
socialPosts.caption: Episode 14 of the Upanishadic Wisdom Series. Pujya Gopal Baba unpacks the eternal dialogue between Nachiketa and Yama regarding life, death, and self-realization. Like, subscribe, and share with spiritual seekers.

socialPosts.title: Akshaya Patra: Over 10,000 Meals Distributed Today
socialPosts.caption: In the spirit of Mother Annapoorna, no visiting pilgrim returns hungry. Pure satvik prasad prepared with utmost hygiene, love, and devotion. #Annadanam #ServiceToManIsServiceToGod

socialPosts.title: Silence Amongst the Pines - Rishikesh Tapovan Retreat
socialPosts.caption: Breathe in the prana of the Himalayas. Registrations for the 10-day Winter Dhyana Camp are now open online via our digital portal.

socialPosts.title: Vedic Gurukul Students Reciting Taittiriya Upanishad
socialPosts.caption: Preserving unbroken lineages of oral transmission. Our young vatu scholars chanting with authentic svara and precision.

socialPosts.title: Special Reminder: Maha Kumbha Satsang Registration
socialPosts.caption: 🙏 Namaste Devotee! Offline registration counters will have high queue times. Please use the mobile QR code or website to confirm your family registration beforehand.

socialPosts.title: Live Stream Announcement: Vrindavan Raas Leela Festival
socialPosts.caption: Join live from any corner of the world as traditional artists present the divine pastimes of Sri Krishna on Margashirsha Shukla Ashtami.

socialPosts.title: Winter Blanket Drive: Reaching 5,000 Remote Pilgrims
socialPosts.caption: Bringing warmth to those enduring sub-zero temperatures. Your micro-donations translate into direct comfort on the ground. Join hands with Gopal Baba Seva Trust.

socialPosts.title: Ayurvedic Wisdom for Winter Vata Balance
socialPosts.caption: Simple seasonal dietary adjustments to preserve vitality, digestion, and calmness as cold winds set in.

socialPosts.title: Ekadashi Fasting Schedule & Timing
socialPosts.caption: Utpanna Ekadashi Parana timings and recommended fasting foods for devotees.

socialPosts.title: Yamuna Sandhya Arati Glimpse
socialPosts.caption: Devotional lamps dancing on the silver waters of river Yamuna. Radhe Radhe!

socialPosts.title: How to Practice Mindfulness in Daily Life
socialPosts.caption: Short clip from satsang with Pujya Babaji explaining karma yoga in everyday work.

socialPosts.title: Modern Solar Kitchen Powers Holy Prasadam
socialPosts.caption: Blending timeless Vedic Annadanam with green renewable energy technology.

socialPosts.title: Cow Milk Distribution to Village Primary Schools
socialPosts.caption: Fresh nutritious A2 milk delivered daily to over 300 children in surrounding villages.

socialPosts.title: Guided Meditation for Relieving Anxiety & Stress
socialPosts.caption: A 20-minute guided session by senior monk Swami Bodhananda.

socialPosts.title: Volunteer Seva Allocation for Gita Jayanti
socialPosts.caption: Volunteers who registered for food distribution are requested to report at Kitchen Block B by 8:00 AM.

socialPosts.title: Spiritual Reading of the Day: Bhagavad Gita Ch 4.24
socialPosts.caption: 'Brahmarpanam Brahma Havir...' Understanding how the offering, the fire, and the seeker are all one Supreme Reality.

socialPosts.title: Transparent Audited Balance Sheet 2025-26
socialPosts.caption: Every rupee donated serves pilgrimage welfare and dharma. Inspect our certified balance sheets online.
